lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for French Polynesia through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset includes approximately 122,200 building polygons with structural attributes (levels, materials) and address information, with AI-based completeness estimates indicating ~100% coverage of the region.
